VHL Standings

Source: R/vhl.R
vhl_standings.Rd

League standings of one regular season (/standings/league/; /standings/regular/ ignores the season).

Usage

vhl_standings(season, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025/26; the calendar covers 2010/11 on). With stage it is mapped to the site's tournament id, see vhl_tn().

return_parsed

TRUE (default) returns the parsed tibble; FALSE returns the page's parsed record (a named list, the sdv-internal-refs capture shape, plus _request with the season, stage, tn and the ids asked for).

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble with one row per team:

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025/26).
stagecharacterSeason stage: regular or playoff.
tnintegerTournament id of the season stage (2025/26 regular season = 1374, playoffs = 1375); vhl_tn maps season + stage to it.
rankintegerRank (unlabelled first column).
teamcharacterTeam short name (Latin; the report tables' form).
team_season_idintegerTeam-season id (khl/ terminology): one id per team per tournament, from the KHL's sequence (khl/: Spartak = 14934 in 1369; here Metallurg = 15017 in 1374). The {id} of /calendar/{tn}/0/{id}/ and /stats/players/{tn}/all/{id}/. Not the stable club id (*_club_id) and not the team page id.
games_playedintegerGames played (GP).
winsintegerRegulation wins (W).
ot_winsintegerOvertime wins (OTW).
so_winsintegerShootout wins (SOW).
so_lossesintegerShootout losses (SOL).
ot_lossesintegerOvertime losses (OTL).
lossesintegerRegulation losses (L).
goals_forintegerGoals for (left side of the G column '226-131').
goals_againstintegerGoals against (right side of the G column).
pointsintegerPoints (PTS): 2 per win of any kind, 1 per OT or SO loss.

With return_parsed = FALSE, the page's parsed record (a named list) instead.

Details

Regular season only: the site's playoff standings are not read.

Source: GET https://www.vhlru.ru/en/standings/league/{season}/ (server-rendered HTML, keyless; parsed with rvest). Unofficial use of a public source; payloads are not redistributed.

Owner flag (sanctions)

The VHL is run by Russian league operators, and several clubs are owned or sponsored by sanctioned state companies. Fetching on your own machine is fine; a published data release or a hosted mirror of this data needs the owner's sanctions / legal sign-off first.

Errors

  • fastRhockey_no_data: the VHL has nothing for the request (a season without that stage, a game not in the season's calendar, an unknown game, player or team page).

  • fastRhockey_bad_request: a bad season / stage / id, a missing argument, or HTTP 400 / 422.

  • fastRhockey_asset_fetch: the page could not be fetched, or it is not the page asked for (another season, game or player; a missing table or header drift).

See also

Other VHL Functions: vhl_game_info(), vhl_goalie_box(), vhl_goalie_stats(), vhl_goals(), vhl_pbp(), vhl_penalties(), vhl_player(), vhl_player_box(), vhl_player_career(), vhl_roster(), vhl_schedule(), vhl_skater_stats(), vhl_tn()
